attempts.summary: Configured node1 as an internal DNS resolver using dnsmasq, resolving inventory-api.internal to node2's IP (10.100.174.11) and forwarding all other queries upstream. Configured node2's NetworkManager eth0 connection profile to use node1 (10.100.174.10) as its DNS resolver, persisted via ipv4.dns/ipv4.ignore-auto-dns. Verified resolution end-to-end from node2, then restarted each node one at a time, confirmed a changed boot ID as proof of actual restart, and verified full recovery of dnsmasq and DNS resolution on both nodes afterward.
